name: Glint
author: Erin Carter
description: Moonlight on dark open water: a horizon sits in the upper third and a vertical glitter path of anisotropic specular highlights descends toward the viewer, densifying near the horizon. A slow two-swell heave rocks the glints up and down and flickers them asynchronously through zero, so the sea never resets.

params.label: Heave speed
params.effect: Speed of the swell that rocks the glints and drives their flicker, from glassy calm to a restless chop.

params.label: Glint size
params.effect: CSS-pixel height of one highlight (its width is about four times this via the anisotropic stretch).

params.label: Path width
params.effect: Width of the glitter column at the bottom of the frame — narrow gives a thin moonbeam lane, wide floods the lower frame with sparkle.
